newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday amid thin buying interest, traders said.
They said European and Singapore dealers bought rubber at 46.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for August/September shipment with a total quantity of 200 tonnes.
Offer prices were stable in other centres, which generally saw no trading because most traders were unwilling to sell at low levels.
"Offer prices are generally stable, but we expect offer prices to decline tomorrow because the market has experienced a downtrend amid a lack of fresh factors," said one trader.
"The market has also looked at the price movement in Thailand because the country is selling rubber at much cheaper prices," said another trader.
SIR20 was being offered at 47.00 fob Medan, 46.25 fob Padang and Surabaya and 46.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
